town_statements.text: Our aim is to maintain fund balance levels no lower than 50% but ideally higher.
town_statements.note: Verbatim from the document. Wrapping whitespace collapsed; wording unchanged.

town_statements.text: The projected drop in fund balance levels by 24 percentage points, from 78% in FY27 to 54% in FY29, is concerning.
town_statements.note: Verbatim from the document. Wrapping whitespace collapsed; wording unchanged.

town_statements.text: While no property tax increase is proposed in FY27 as this year’s deficit is relatively small and savings levels are strong.

town_statements.text: After the audit, most years end up with deficits less than projected or with an actual surplus generated.

facts.source_detail:
stated in prose: …Sewer Rates
A 7.5% increase is recommended…
facts.note: Recommended for each of the next three years. Matches the water increase.

facts.source_detail: stated in prose: …$15 per ERU* increase over FY26 fee…
facts.note: Per Equivalent Residential Unit. The budget message does not state whether this is a monthly or annual figure, so no annual household total is derived from it here.

facts.source_detail: stated in prose: …until meeting the equivalent of 2 cents on the property tax rate…
facts.note: The board agreed in FY2024 to raise affordable-housing spending annually until it reaches this share of the tax rate.

facts.source_detail: stated in prose: …which is equivalent to approximately 2.6 cents on the tax rate…
facts.note: The FY2027 salary and benefit increase, expressed as tax-rate cents.

facts.source_detail: stated in prose: …about a $440 annual increase on a $400,000 home…
facts.note: The town's own worked example for the FY2029 deficit scenario. Useful as a cross-check on the household calculator: at 51.3 cents a $400,000 home pays about $2,052, and each cent adds $40, so $440 implies roughly an 11-cent increase — consistent with the text's 'over 10 cents'.

facts.source_detail: stated in prose: …set the FY27 funding level at $110,000…
facts.note: Town funding for nonprofit partners, set after a public hearing.

facts.source_detail: stated in prose: …maintain fund balance levels no lower than 50%…
facts.note: The town's own stated minimum for fund balance, as a share of a year's spending. Read from the same sentence as the `savings_floor` quotation so the figure and the wording beside it cannot disagree.
